fields.name: OrderNumber
fields.description: Human-facing order number, generated at placement.

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: IAM UserId of the ordering customer. Set from the authenticated caller on create, never from client input.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Draft, PendingPayment, Confirmed, Cancelled, or Completed.

fields.name: PaymentStatus
fields.description: Pending, Authorized, Paid, PartiallyRefunded, Refunded, or Failed.

fields.name: FulfillmentStatus
fields.description: Unallocated, Allocated, Picking, Packed, PartiallyShipped, Shipped, or Delivered.

fields.name: Items
fields.description: Line items at the time of placement, with price/tax/discount snapshots — never re-derive these from the live catalog.

fields.name: ShippingAddress
fields.description: Snapshot of the shipping address at order placement time.

fields.name: BillingAddress
fields.description: Snapshot of the billing address at order placement time.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: ISO currency code for all monetary fields on this order.

fields.name: SubTotal
fields.description: Sum of line totals before tax/shipping/discount.

fields.name: TaxTotal
fields.description: Total tax across all lines.

fields.name: DiscountTotal
fields.description: Total discount across all lines and order-level promotions.

fields.name: ShippingTotal
fields.description: Shipping charge for this order.

fields.name: GrandTotal
fields.description: The actual amount charged: SubTotal + TaxTotal + ShippingTotal - DiscountTotal.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: Coupon code applied at checkout, if any.

fields.name: IdempotencyKey
fields.description: Client-generated key reused on every retry of the same checkout attempt. IsUniqueData alone is a check-then-act query, not a real constraint — a genuine MongoDB unique index must also be created on this field before this is trustworthy for production checkout (see DATA_GATEWAY_STORAGE_FEATURES_AND_SECURITY.md item B2).

fields.name: SalesChannelType
fields.description: Ecommerce, POS, MobileApp, Marketplace, or Wholesale.

fields.name: PlacedDate
fields.description: When the order was placed.

fields.name: ConfirmedDate
fields.description: When payment/confirmation completed.

fields.name: CancelledDate
fields.description: When the order was cancelled, if applicable.
